=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2713-3406 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The #9939 comment, the `RB_SYNC_MERGE_DEFERRED="false"` reset and the sync-site guard branch now sit between `review_head_gate_post_status` and `if/elif gh pr merge` at the merge (2713→2717), terminal (2825→2829) and sync (3398→3401-3406) sites, which breaks the adjacency contract at tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:97-99.
  WHY: CI run 45093838558 fails with `assert 'review_head_gate_post_status ...' in '          RB_SYNC_MERGE_DEFERRED="false"'`, which turns `lint` red and posts `ci/final` as failure. Four reviewers rated it BLOCKER (mapped to critical); gemini gave no severity. Fix proposals: move the reset and comment above the post at the merge and terminal sites, then either widen the contract test to a window for the sync site or reorder there, and re-check the windows in tests/test_pr_base_freshness_gate.py::test_review_rb_judge_gates_both_merge_sites.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:13594-13641 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new blocked-merge guard in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (cited as 15724-15735) returns 1 before any merge attempt, but test_final_merge_refusal_keeps_github_error_and_mergeable_state still expects the legacy attempt-and-record path to set `final_merge_error` and post "## ⚠️ Final merge blocked".
  WHY: CI fails with `AssertionError: assert '' == 'Final PR #35...y is failing.'` at tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:13628 in the orchestrate-poll shards and tests-system-python shard 12, which turns `lint` red. Four reviewers rated it BLOCKER (mapped to critical); gemini gave no severity. The fix proposals disagree: sonnet suggests env_overrides={"PR_SYNC_MERGE_BLOCKED_GUARD_ENABLED": "false"}, glm and luna suggest asserting the new deferral outcome, and minimax names both.
- tests/test_review_rb_judge_label_propagation.py:2586-2917 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `@pytest.mark.parametrize("mergeable_state", ...)` test_merge_with_followup_defers_sync_merge_when_github_reports_blocked cannot be called by the file's direct-run main(), which calls `func()` with no arguments, and CI runs the file directly (.github/workflows/ci.yml:2227-2230).
  WHY: tests-promote-stall-and-review logs `missing 1 required positional argument: 'mergeable_state'` and `83 passed, 1 failed`, which turns `lint` red. Four reviewers rated it BLOCKER (mapped to critical); gemini gave no severity. Fix: drop the decorator and `import pytest`, and loop over ("blocked", "unknown", None) inside the test body.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:148 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The new scripts/ci_final_status.sh is referenced in README.md and agents.d/9939-final-ci-status-gate.md but is not registered in the Scripts section of docs/INVENTORY.md and has no exemption, so tests/inventory_parity.py reports it missing.
  WHY: inventory_parity.py runs in tests-release-and-log-analysis, which failed on head 4ddf8494, and this is the likely cause of that fourth failed `needs` of `lint`. Rated BLOCKER (mapped to critical).
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:2492 | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The tests-release-and-log-analysis job failed on the PR head, but the log excerpt is truncated before the failing test or step is named.
  WHY: The failed job helps fail the `lint` aggregate, so `ci/final` posts failure. glm suggests it may be an inherited merge-base failure that still needs confirming. Both rated it MAJOR (mapped to high). It possibly relates to the docs/INVENTORY.md finding above, which sonnet identifies as the likely cause.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml (~line 1340) and .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml (~line 2207)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff guards only scripts/review_rb_judge.sh and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh. The direct `gh pr merge` calls at `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:1340` and `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2207` have no `_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard` or `mergeable_state` check, so the admin PAT can still merge a blocked PR. Reviewers treat this as a deferral outside the files_touched grant that a follow-up issue must close before owner step O3. Severity disagreement: sonnet NIT, gemini MAJOR, minimax BLOCKER. glm mentions it only as a note (an accepted deferral), not as a finding.
